claims.text: The Croatian research group lacked federal funding, which prevented them from creating a prototype machine translation system.
Unlike their counterparts in the USA and USSR, the Croatian group had to manage without an actual computer, limiting their research to theoretical results.
The research was primarily a military effort in other countries, which received significant political support and funding, unlike the Croatian group.
